tbesh_html: (Hithpael) to reckon genealogically, enrol on a genealogy, enrol, be enrolled

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; to sprout; used only as denominative from H3188 (יַחַשׂ);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.
